:::{.callout-note collapse="false"}
This page showcases my professional work including talks, projects, and external writing. Sections with no content are automatically hidden.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
  const sections = ['talks', 'projects', 'writing'];
  
  sections.forEach(section => {
    const sectionEl = document.getElementById(section);
    if (sectionEl) {
      const items = sectionEl.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
      
      // If there are no items in the section, hide the entire section
      if (items.length === 0) {
        const headingEl = document.querySelector(`h2[id="${section}-heading"]`);
        if (headingEl) {
          headingEl.style.display = 'none';
        }
        sectionEl.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
